entries.8101e0c24f23649a: This business manufactures and sells automotive parts, including spark plugs, glow plugs and various automotive sensors. In Japan, the company manufactures and sells products itself, and also supplies raw materials and parts to domestic subsidiaries, including Nittoku Spark Tech WKS Co., Ltd. and Ceramic Sensor Co., Ltd., entrusting them with manufacturing. Overseas, Niterra Brazil Ltd. manufactures and sells spark plugs on an integrated basis, and subsidiaries in North America, China, South Korea, Southeast Asia and Europe, including Niterra North America Co., Ltd., assemble finished products from the company’s parts and raw materials and sell them, while Wells Vehicle Electronics, L.P. manufactures and sells automotive-related products on an integrated basis. Overseas sales subsidiaries, including Niterra EMEA Ltd., purchase finished products and sell them to customers in each region. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥587,505 million (¥542,800 million in the previous year), the larger of the two reportable segments.
entries.8c2b9352a35af14e: This business manufactures and sells cutting tools for machine tools, industrial ceramic products, components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, semiconductor components such as IC packages, fuel cells, silicon nitride-related products, and medical oxygen concentrators. In Japan, the company, NTK Ceratec Co., Ltd., Niterra Materials Co., Ltd. and others manufacture and sell products, and raw materials and parts are supplied to NTK Ceramic Co., Ltd. and others, entrusting them with manufacturing. Overseas, CAIRE Inc. (U.S.) manufactures and sells products on an integrated basis, and sales subsidiaries such as Niterra North America Co., Ltd. purchase products and sell them to customers in each region. Through an organizational change effective April 1, 2025, fuel cells, silicon nitride-related products and other items were transferred to this segment from the former “Ceramics” and “New Business” segments. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥129,935 million (¥102,287 million in the previous year).
